result.headline: Throttle commanded to 0% at 89.527 s and never recovered; altitude fell afterwards. Source of the cut not recorded.
result.explanation: Throttle command dropped 44 to 0% and the motor channel followed to 1100 us, with no mode change or event logged. Pilot or autopilot cut, battery or power cut-off, and ESC or motor fault are not separable here.

evidence.shows: Altitude fell from 51.607 m to 20.48 m between 88 and 104 s: an unpowered descent

evidence.quote: EVENT t=0.345 s controller.event[mavros: Battery] mavros: Battery: WARN: Low voltage
evidence.shows: Only one event in the recording: a low-voltage warning at start-up, not repeated later. A battery link to the cut is possible but not shown.

checked.result: One event only (Low voltage warning at 0.345 s). No failsafe or mode change near the throttle drop at 89.527 s.

checked.check: Sequence of departures from baseline, 85 to 105 s
checked.result: Yaw setpoint left baseline first (85.101 s), then ch2 (90.697 s) and throttle (90.769 s); pitch and altitude followed. The sequence tool's times are later than the CHANGE-line times (89.527 s and 89.944 s).
checked.about: Propulsion cut as the earliest sign of the descent

checked.result: Throttle 45 to 0% (flagged frozen), ch2 1460 to 1100 us. Roll tracking error rose 7.82x (0.739 to 5.784 deg) while the roll setpoint median jumped from 2.175 to 44.15 deg.
checked.about: Propulsion loop is the place to look; roll tracking change is likely a manoeuvre or effect

checked.result: ch2 holds 1100 us and throttle 0% for the rest of the window. ch1 (roll) keeps moving between 1458 and 1542 us. Altitude 51.607 to 20.48 m.
checked.about: Fault is confined to the propulsion channel

checked.check: Same pattern at start-up, t=8.7 s
checked.result: Throttle was 2% and ch2 1116 us before 8.7 s, then they rose to 38% and 1400 us. Throttle was low before and recovered, which looks like a launch or arming sequence.
